headline: Lilipole
title: Lilipole | Frog Kick Starter | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Lilipole is a stage one Water Aniimo that can swim, and it evolves into Scrubbit at level sixty two. Limber-Up Rapid Kicks has power thirty, costs fifteen energy and restores a little health. Its second skill is called Frogs Love Baths. Homeland work is Water level one. It is a playful swimmer that splashes everyone nearby. It is an easy Water pick for new trainers. Would you raise a Lilipole? Comment below!
description: Lilipole guide: a stage 1 Water Aniimo that can swim and evolves into Scrubbit at Lv. 62. Limber-Up Rapid Kicks (power 30), Frogs Love Baths and level 1 Water Homeland work. Checked on aniimo.gg and metabot.gg in November 2026.
joke: Lilipole is basically a frog that mastered kickboxing.
